title: Volume and Surface Area of Prisms and Cylinders
seo_title: Volume of Prisms and Cylinders – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the volume and surface area of cuboids, prisms and cylinders; solve problems with capacity. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on volume and surface area: cuboids, triangular prisms, cylinders and capacity problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Prism: V = area of cross-section × length
body_html:
How to think about it

  • The volume of a prism = area of the cross-section × length.
  • A cylinder is a prism with a circular cross-section: V = πr²h.
  • Surface area is the total area of all the faces.

Examples

Example

Cylinder with r = 7 cm and h = 10 cm

22/7 × 49 × 10

Answer: 1,540 cm³

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using the diameter as the radiusr = d ÷ 2.
Adding instead of multiplyingVolume is area × length.
Missing faces in surface areaCount every face.
